definitions.explanation: The ability to understand spoken language, or the act of doing so. Used mainly in language education and proficiency testing contexts.

notes:
USAGE:
{聴解|ちょうかい} is used almost exclusively in educational and testing contexts. It is one of the standard skill categories in language proficiency tests such as the JLPT (Japanese Language Proficiency Test).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聴解|ちょうかい}{力|りょく} (listening comprehension ability)
- {聴解|ちょうかい}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (listening comprehension questions)
- {聴解|ちょうかい}⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧ (listening comprehension practice)
- {聴解|ちょうかい}セクション (listening section)

SIMILAR WORDS:
Paired with ⟦{読解|どっかい}→読解：15056_dokkai⟧ (reading comprehension) in language testing. While ⟦{読解|どっかい}→読解：15056_dokkai⟧ covers written text, {聴解|ちょうかい} covers spoken audio.
